title: Substituting for Riley and local musicians
summary: He fills in on Riley's job, recalls playing with Big Al Lewis, and asks about Walter Deku and a songster named Paul Anderson.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: By the way, you know where Walter Deku is? Have you seen him lately?
No, I don't know where he's at. He had been up in… He's around Baconda Street somewhere.
Well, around Tom Alberts there next door. I don't think he's there now, somebody told me. I'm not sure, I have to check with Tom and Mark.
Now there's, now I don't know if you know this guy, he's, what is this boy's name? His name is Paul Anderson. I think his name is Paul Anderson. He's a songster.
No, I don't think I know him.

No, you don't know. He used to sing in the alley with, that guy is going away now. He's, he was a cornet player. All those guys are going now. I don't know where they at, but they all, they all gone away. And we used to, I used to play with, oh there's so many of them guys. I just can't call all their names.
